description: Search the Crela marketplace for reviewed software, apps and games you buy once and own - no subscription. Returns only approved, publicly listed tools, each with a url to its Crela page where it can be bought. Use limit (1-50) to keep the response small and page through the rest; get_software returns the full detail of one.

lang.description: Language of the software user interface, e.g. "de". Not the programming language.

page.description: 1-based page, see total_pages in the response

query.description: Full-text search over title and description

name: search_software
title: Search Crela software
